anomalies.observed: All J5 Ethernet data and center-tap pins are unconnected. The Ethernet-related U5 nets contain only U5 pins, so the jack has no connection to the module.
anomalies.expected: If J5 is intended to provide the specified Ethernet interface, its data pairs should connect to the intended module Ethernet nets; otherwise the jack should not be presented as a usable Ethernet port.

anomalies.impact: The switched EPD rail has less bypass capacitance than specified, which may reduce local decoupling during display operation.
